resources.string: Keeps the content filter switched on and stops it from being removed without the parent PIN.
Managed: drawbridge is the device owner
Not managed — restrictions cannot be enforced. Provision with adb or a QR code first.

This one-time recovery code is the only way back in if the PIN is forgotten. It is not stored anywhere you can read it again, and there is no email reset — that would mean tying this device to an account.

Enter the parent PIN, or the one-time recovery code. This lifts every restriction and stops the filter. Nothing is erased and no factory reset is needed.

The content filter, app blocking and all device restrictions will be switched off. Apps that were hidden become available again. No data is lost.
